guard: A cancellation that arrives while `begin` is in flight still stops the dispatch: the handler is never asked, and the pending entry settles cancelled. (FAIL-FAST suite: markers are upstream of the cells they guard.)

mutations.name: the boundary never re-checks cancellation on the far side of the begin append
mutations.expectRed: the handler is never asked for the effect a cancellation overtook inside `begin`
mutations.completionMarker: ok an arm whose in-flight effect lands BEFORE the frontier runs its pure tail and wins
mutations.cell: the handler is never asked for the effect a cancellation overtook inside `begin`
mutations.note: With the re-check gone the loser's effect is dispatched against the world after the race already picked its winner, and the journal records the loser `ok` — the section 11 cell holds the handler call list and the entry status. The suite is fail-fast, so the completion marker is the last line printed BEFORE the reddened cell (section 10's final check), the only place a marker can appear on a killed run.
